content: Do I need to lift heavy to build muscle?

No, you don't have to. Research shows muscle growth is similar across a wide rep range, roughly 5 to 30 reps, as long as your sets finish close to failure (about 0-3 reps left in the tank). Heavier loads in the 5-10 rep range are time-efficient, and they also help your strength.

Since you're chasing a 100 kg bench in three months, heavy work matters for you. Strength is specific, so you need to practice lifting heavy weights. Keep the bulk of your work in the 5-10 rep range, and add lighter sets for volume. 💪
